_comment: Generated by scripts/difficulty/report.py. Boards whose tiling forces unavoidable coin flips, so their win rate cannot reach the difficulty's target. Both front-ends read this to warn the player and to deal these boards less often at random.

medium.reason: the tiling forces coin flips in the endgame, so even with the fewest mines that stop the opening click clearing the board outright (9, 3%) it plays harder than this difficulty's target; fewer mines would only make it a board the first click can win
